response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) AS rec_cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), side_avg AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(avg_net_fee) AS side_avg FROM grp GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT g.orderslink, g.dealedge AS side, g.avg_net_fee, g.rec_cnt, g.avg_net_fee - s.side_avg AS diff FROM grp g JOIN side_avg s ON g.dealedge = s.dealedge WHERE g.avg_net_fee > s.side_avg ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
